organize.tip: Puts a request in the chat box asking the AI agent to write this chat's results as a research note.
organize.prompt: Write the results of this chat's analysis as a research note. If a note for the same question already exists, update that note.

record.hint: Entries the AI agent logged while working. They are the evidence behind research notes.

status.pendingTip: No researcher has reviewed this note yet.
status.supersededTip: A newer note replaces this note's conclusion.

badge.decisionsTip: This note has decisions to answer.
badge.formatTip: Parts of the note are missing. Use Write note to have them fixed.

empty.title: No research notes yet
empty.body: When an analysis has results, the AI agent writes a note that starts with the results in the 연구노트 folder.

error.load: Research notes could not be read. Open them again in a moment.
error.status: The note status was not changed. Try again.

detail.supersededBy: A newer note replaces this note.

decision.title: Decisions to make

instruction.label: Separate instruction (write your own)
instruction.placeholder: Write what the AI agent should do next, e.g. rerun after uploading the sample table

decision.sendTip: Sends the chosen answers to the chat that wrote the note in one message.
decision.sendBlocked: Choose an answer for each decision, then send them together.
decision.filled: The chat cannot send right now, so the answers are in its chat box. Check them there and send.
decision.sendFailed: Could not open the chat that wrote the note, so the answers were not sent. If many chat tabs are open, close one and send again.

prompt.head: Answering the decisions of the note "{title}".
prompt.open: Not answered yet: decision {numbers}. Leave them open.
prompt.tail: Continue the work according to these answers and update the note.
